ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed JOUR 460 BMT Broadcast Meteorology (SP 34819) should not register for JOUR 427. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. *Please note: This section will be taught asynchronous (no live sessions).
